svg.text: Bar 60 x 24, 480 long. Centres 420 apart, 30 from each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Round both ends to a 30 radius about the centres.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Crank end: bore 30.5 for the 30 mm crank pin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Knee end: bore 40.5 for the 40 mm knee pin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The 420 centre distance sets the stroke: hold it within 0.3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: sits on the centre line between the two crank plates

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (4 mm each side) and between the knee spacers.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: measure the centre distance with the two pins fitted.
